title: Raman Scattering
definition: Raman scattering is the inelastic scattering of a photon by molecules, resulting in a change in frequency and energy of the scattered photons, discovered by Indian physicist Sir C.V. Raman in 1928.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for UPSC CSE Science & Technology syllabus under physics, space/cosmic physics, and applications in nanotechnology, forensics, pharmaceuticals, and industrial material characterization.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Raman Scattering.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and analytical applications.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
